# Pondy Guide

> Pondy Guide (pondyguide.com) is an independent reference guide to Pondicherry/Puducherry, India. It covers the city's French colonial history, historical figures, French institutions, the White Town street grid, heritage landmarks, Auroville, festivals, restaurants, hotels, and practical travel information. Content is also available in Tamil (/ta) and French (/fr).
